title: Hollis (Woodward's Cot) successfully teaches the missing third recall-note ('you catch what he never could... it drops, low and short') and the huntsman's horn's item text immediately updates to 'sound it whole at the Hunt's Stand's horn-post, with all three notes known' — yet the Hunt's Stand's free 'weigh what this grief asks' still reports 'One note is missing still: read the cadence from the hunt's roll,' and the 'sound the recall whole' action does not appear until the separate 'read the roll's cadence' check in the Lodge Hall is also passed. The quest text ('the last waits with Hollis, the lodge hall's roll, or Fry — whichever you haven't tried') implies any one source suffices; only the roll actually flips the completion flag.
where: Kingswood / The Woodward's Cot (talk to Hollis) and The Hunt's Stand — Muster Court (weigh what this grief asks)
